title: microsorum ensiforme
intro: Microsorum ensiforme, commonly known as Water Fern or Water Clover, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is known for its ability to thrive in moist environments and is often used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Microsorum ensiforme contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
